title: From search to review
intro: An illustrative walkthrough using restaurants in Boston. This explains the workflow; it is not a live search result or a customer case study.

steps.title: Choose your source
steps.text: Choose Google Places for operational businesses with no website listed in their returned record. Choose Foursquare for business listings with available websites, phones, and social profiles.

steps.title: Enter a focused query
steps.text: Enter restaurants in Boston, Massachusetts, USA and choose a target such as 10 leads. Connect your own provider key and review its billing before starting. The target is not a guaranteed result count.

steps.title: Review the returned details
steps.text: Check that the business type and location match your intent. In Foursquare, try the website, phone, and social filters. A missing field means the provider did not return that information, not that it does not exist.

steps.title: Plan your next action
steps.text: Verify the business and contact details before outreach. Use saving or team-sharing actions only where available and permitted by source terms. A public listing is not marketing consent.
